company.name: Tamra Capital
company.shortDescription: Tamra Capital offers investment management and financial advisory services for individuals.
company.description: Tamra Capital is a CMA-licensed financial institution pioneering robo-advisory in Saudi Arabia. As the first to introduce this concept locally, Tamra Capital is redefining how individuals and employers approach investing and financial wellness. Through data-driven strategies, Sharia-compliant portfolios, and a human-centric experience, Tamra Capital empowers users to build long-term wealth with confidence. In just two and a half years, Tamra Capital has grown to serve over 240,000 registered users with more than $410 million in Assets Under Management (AUM), positioning itself as a market leader in the digital investment landscape in Saudi Arabia.
